slab-merklix-snapshots-20261022.author_recorded_subject: lotus_v2: slab-backed persistent Merklix snapshots with lazy hashing and MinHash
slab-merklix-snapshots-20261022.author_recorded_rationale: Replace the append-only mempool transaction arena and the full-mempool reconciliation rebuild with one slab-backed, path-compressed, reference-counted persistent Subtree A tree: O(1) structural pins for advertised/hashed versions, in-place updates of exclusively owned paths, lazy CAS-published digests, slot reclamation with generations, and an incrementally maintained bottom-k MinHash pinned atomically with each version.
slab-merklix-snapshots-20261022.concrete_problem: TxOverlayArena appended a fresh root-to-leaf path for every admission/removal and never reclaimed it until reset; epoch freezes deep-copied the arena; block re-anchoring re-inserted and re-hashed every transaction; full-mempool reconciliation copied every transaction reference under cs_main+mempool.cs and rebuilt and eagerly hashed a private trie per capture.
slab-merklix-snapshots-20261022.split_mechanism: A distinct native data-structure purpose appended after canonical 527. Existing 527 owners remain byte-identical; the replaced arena is kept as a legacy reference for equivalence tests and A/B microbenchmarks.
semantic_invariants: Consensus Subtree A, TransactionRoot, block validity and transaction validation are unchanged; tree roots equal TransactionSubtreeA for every membership.

A node is mutated in place only when every node on its path from the writer's root has refcount 1; all trees sharing a store are mutated under one writer lock (mempool cs in production). Only the writer increments reference counts.
Pinned snapshots are immutable; later writes copy touched paths and can never change a pinned membership, count, version, payload charge or sketch.
Digests are derived caches: Dirty->Busy->Clean compare-and-swap publication, losers never write, only exclusively owned nodes return to Dirty. Ordinary readers never hash.

Slots are reclaimed only at refcount zero; every allocation assigns a fresh store-wide64-bit identity, never reset across trimming; weak handles resolve only with a matching generation and an increment-if-nonzero.
MinHash is bottom-k (k=64) over (TxId, TxHash) with fixed public SipHash keys; it is a similarity/fetching hint, never authenticated membership, voting or finality input.
Scope-5 frames are version 2 (user approved: no released v1 peers); offers carry exactly min(64, count) ascending sketch values.
Nothing is claimed lock-free: allocation and batched frees take a store mutex.
